Read a Qualtrics response export

Source: R/responses.R
read_responses.Rd

Reads a response CSV as it is, so you can build per-respondent inputs, such as a words_per_line vector from device metadata, for respondent_burden(). Every column is read as text and keeps its name unchanged. A raw Qualtrics export keeps its two header rows (question labels and ImportId), so the result has two more rows than there are respondents. respondent_burden() accepts a vector of either length: when it removes the header rows, it drops the matching entries too.

Usage

read_responses(x, arg = "responses")

Arguments

x

Path to a CSV file, or a data frame, which is returned unchanged.

arg

Argument name used in error messages.

Value

A data frame with one row per CSV row, all columns character.

Examples

csv <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
writeLines(c("ResponseId,Q1", "Response ID,Q1 text", "R_1,yes"), csv)
read_responses(csv)
#>    ResponseId      Q1
#> 1 Response ID Q1 text
#> 2         R_1     yes
